unspecified.behavior: Inside the native shell without src, an onError prop is forwarded to ShellVideoPlayer, which ignores it, so it is never called.

scores.reason: No caller passes onError without src today. An addon always passes src, so nobody sees a silent drop in ordinary use.

It needs a caller that passes onError without src inside the iOS shell. The documented addon pattern (ADDON-DEVELOPMENT.md:1402-1404) always passes both, so this rarely happens, and when it does a playback error just isn't reported to the caller.

unspecified.behavior: On a src change under the same videoId, in a real browser the old controller's teardown save reads the new element's reset currentTime (0), so the last up-to-5 s of progress on the old source is not written.

scores.reason: The spec states no caller changes src under one videoId, so this needs use that does not occur.
It needs an addon to swap src while the same video stays open, which is rare. The user then loses at most the last few seconds of resume position on the old source.

unspecified.behavior: A whitespace-only src string is truthy, so it is used as the element source and selects the browser player inside the shell, instead of falling back like "".

scores.reason: Only a malformed caller-supplied src triggers it, which is outside ordinary first-party use.
Only a first-party addon author's own bug passes a whitespace-only src, which is outside ordinary use. The player then shows a broken source instead of falling back.
